candidate_name: Punta Europa second LNG train (Gas Mega Hub expansion)
sponsor_or_proposer: Government of Equatorial Guinea / EG LNG (ConocoPhillips-operated); contingent on cross-border feed-gas (Cameroon)
current_state: Concept/aspiration only. EG's Gas Mega Hub aggregates backfill gas (Alen first gas 2021, Alba from Jan 2024, Aseng next) to sustain the existing EG LNG Train 1 (3.7 mtpa, operating). Officials have floated a possible second LNG train at Punta Europa IF additional regional feed gas (e.g. talks with Cameroon) materialises. No FID, no sponsor commitment, no firm capacity/timeline for a NEW train.
missing_threshold_elements: No concrete step taken toward a new train (no FEED, no FID, no firm feed-gas contract); 'second train' is conditional on Cameroon cross-border gas talks.
watch_for: A firm Cameroon (or other) cross-border feed-gas SPA; a FEED award or FID for a second Punta Europa train; EG LNG/ConocoPhillips IR confirming a new liquefaction train (distinct from backfill to Train 1).
notes: Existing GEM Punta Europa T2 (4.4 mtpa) is already 'cancelled' (a different, older expansion). The Aseng/Alba/Alen items are upstream backfill feed-gas projects (not LNG terminals) and are out of scope. Train 1 verified operating 3.7 mtpa; ConocoPhillips exported a cargo from Punta Europa in Jun 2025.
